meta.title: Oscar Antonio Rodríguez Carmona | Full Stack Developer
meta.description: Full stack developer in Mexico City. React, TypeScript, FastAPI and Node.js. Now at ArgusEye, on its diagram editor and a layout engine in Rust and WebAssembly.
meta.ogAlt: Oscar Antonio Rodríguez Carmona, Full Stack Developer

hero.lead: I build web products end to end: React and TypeScript on the front, FastAPI and Node.js services behind them, and the cloud setup that keeps them running.

arguseye.summary: SaaS cybersecurity platform for threat modeling and regulatory compliance.
highlights: Designed the diagram layout and edge-routing engine in Rust, compiled to WebAssembly: hierarchical layout and A* grid routing. It replaced the JavaScript version and has parity tests in CI.
Work on the data flow diagram editor: layers, trust boundaries, connection rules between actors and assets, and keyboard shortcuts.
Built a Slack bot from scratch in Python that lets users look up projects and threats and chat with the platform's AI copilot.
Shipped Slack account linking and read-only API keys that revoke themselves automatically.
Redesigned the company site in Next.js, with a custom blog editor, a careers page and technical SEO.

rommaana.summary: Embedded insurance (Insurance as a Service) for Saudi Arabia. The brand became TrustMango in 2026.
highlights: Lead developer of the React B2B portal: policies, products, coverages, partners, users, analytics and MFA sign-in.
Built the claims app and its FastAPI backend: evidence uploads to Google Cloud Storage with signed URLs, SMS notifications through Twilio and role-based permissions.
Ran the Google Cloud infrastructure with Terraform (Cloud Run, load balancer, CDN and Cloud Armor) and cut the cost of idle services.
Led the technical side of the TrustMango rebrand: new environments and domains, an API docs portal and an English/Arabic landing page shipped in two days.
Owned the frontend and the UX/UI design: flows, screens and components in React and SASS.
Built REST APIs with Node.js and Express on an agile team with code reviews.
Built Angular modules and their business logic.
Wrote APIs with Nest.js and helped document the security policies.
Wrote Java and Spring endpoints for internal systems.
Investigated and fixed critical transactions in Oracle Database.
Built Angular components for an internal tool.

projects.meta: Personal, with the code on GitHub

health-app.summary: Health app with an API, a web client, a mobile app and an AI worker that processes queued jobs.
highlights: The API answers 202 right away and the worker calls the model in the background through BullMQ and Redis; clients poll the job status.
Sessions use 15-minute access tokens and rotating refresh tokens: replaying a spent one revokes the whole family.
Zod schemas and types live in a shared package so the API and the worker can't drift apart.

phantomsneakers.summary: Sneaker store with a React frontend and an Express and MongoDB backend.
highlights: Sign-up and login with JWT and bcrypt-hashed passwords.
PayPal checkout (sandbox) from the cart.

backend.summary: Online store backend with Node.js, Express and MongoDB.
highlights: REST and GraphQL API with an MVC, DAO and DTO structure.
Login with Passport and bcrypt, email notifications with Nodemailer and SMS with Twilio.
Tests with Mocha and a server running in cluster mode.
Cart built on the Context API, with category and product routes in React Router.
Catalog and orders stored in Firebase.

about.title: About
paragraphs: I'm Oscar. I studied Computer Science at IPN and I've worked as a developer since 2022. I'm happiest following a feature all the way through: the screen, the API, the database and the deploy.
JavaScript and TypeScript are still my favorite languages, though lately I spend a lot of time in Rust and Python.
Away from code I draw and tattoo (<tattoo>@ezz.tattoo</tattoo>). For a year I also sold enamel pins (<pins>@meowpin._</pins>).

cv.summary: Full stack developer based in Mexico City.
